evals.prompt: Our /generate endpoint streams SSE lines like data: {"token":"he"} and ends with data: [DONE]. Stream the tokens into a string.
evals.expected_output: Imports '@ahoo-wang/fetcher-eventstream' for side effects, defines a TerminateDetector for '[DONE]', iterates `response.requiredJsonEventStream(detector)` with for await reading `event.data.token`; notes that without the detector JSON.parse throws.

evals.prompt: I must not patch Response.prototype in this library. How do I parse the SSE body?
evals.expected_output: Uses `toServerSentEventStream(response)` and `toJsonServerSentEventStream(stream, detector)` without the side-effect import.

evals.prompt: My decorator endpoint uses JsonEventStreamResultExtractor and crashes at the end of every stream.
evals.expected_output: Explains JsonEventStreamResultExtractor passes no terminator; writes a custom ResultExtractor calling `exchange.requiredResponse.requiredJsonEventStream(detector)` and sets it on the endpoint.

evals.prompt: Stream a GPT-4o chat completion with an API key.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT primarily use this skill: $fetcher-openai-client handles OpenAI chat completions with DoneDetector built in.
